existing_decision.evidence: Read Proof 1.1–3.1 and all five direct supplier interfaces. The hat/quadratic supplier gives the midpoint hat and half the stated quadratic in H10, and linearity gives x(1-x) as used. On (0,1), the Poincare proof gives ||z||2<=||z_prime||2, so a is coercive for the full H1 norm. Direct integration gives a(v,w)=1 and a(w,w)=4, hence Rv=w/4. Its two slopes +/-1/2 give nonlinear residual 1/2; the original slopes 1-2x give two contributions 1/3 each, totaling 2/3. The separable Hilbert evolution-triple interface has exactly these real zero-boundary spaces. The revised title states residual nonpreservation, exactly what this witness proves; it asserts no commutation operator with unspecified codomain. Countable Choice is explicit. Retain the corrected title; no current defect. $$b(x;\tau,v)=(\sigma,\tau)-(u,\operatorname{div}_h\tau)+\langle\widehat u,\tau\cdot n\rangle-(\sigma,\nabla_hv)+\langle\widehat\sigma_n,v\rangle,$$

The local normal-trace surjectivity result supplies the trace-duality separation used in the kernel proof.
